t: The Extreme Wrench is... um... a wrench.$(br2)You can use it to change the input/output mode of parts such as the Access Port or the Fluid Ports.$(br2)The wrench is tagged as a Forge wrench, so you should be able to use it in other mods too.
极限扳手……嗯……就是一把扳手。$(br2)你可以用它来切换访问端口、流体端口等部件的输入/输出模式。$(br2)这把扳手被标记为 Forge 扳手，因此你应该也能在其他模组中使用它。
